title: Quick Lemon Garlic Shrimp and White Bean Skillet
description: This quick lemon garlic shrimp and white bean skillet delivers 35g of protein per serving in just 25 minutes. Plump shrimp and creamy cannellini beans are tossed in a bright citrus herb sauce for a fast high-protein meal.
steps: Pat the shrimp dry with paper towels and season evenly with half of the salt and all of the black pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes until shimmering.
Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook for 2 minutes without moving, then flip and cook for 1 more minute until pink and opaque; transfer the shrimp to a clean plate.

Reduce the heat to medium, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the same skillet, and stir in the minced garlic and red pepper flakes, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant and lightly golden.
Pour in the chicken broth and lemon juice, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon, and simmer for 2 minutes until slightly reduced.
Add the drained cannellini beans, lemon zest, and remaining salt, stirring gently for 3 minutes until heated through.
Fold in the baby spinach and cook for 1 minute until just wilted.
Return the cooked shrimp and any accumulated juices back into the skillet, toss everything together for 1 minute until piping hot, remove from heat, and garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
tips: Use frozen peeled shrimp by thawing them completely under cold running water and patting them thoroughly dry before cooking.
Swap cannellini beans for Great Northern beans or chickpeas if preferred.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
storage: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat gently on the stovetop over medium-low heat.
